method.description: Same 40-program V3 documented penalty set; no new research or evidence coverage changes. Reweighting only, proportional adjustment of earlier overrides rounded to nearest integer; zero remains zero. Hard news breach previously scored 3 now 5. Scores are provisional optimistic calculations; unverified contract clauses not awarded verified safety, no publication. No firm score, affiliate, price promo, forced distribution or ceiling.

Q.label: Qualitative trading restriction without quantified sanction

R4.label: Explicit changes applicable immediately to existing accounts

P4.label: Permanent excess profit deletion, limited/high cap

L2.label: Material cap or fraction withdrawal limit

K2.label: Qualitative position/strategy restrictions with independent scope

X6.label: Severe split reduction / closure strike mechanism

X8.label: Cycle reward reduced to 10% or lost on cumulative strikes

method.warning: Q applies to documented open-ended qualitative risk restrictions, not routine anti-fraud/KYC. General discretionary denial tiers reflect scope and safeguards; proportional overrides preserve previous editorial judgment, not fully calibrated objective criteria. L/F/B grouped as prior experiment; no new penalties inferred. Price not calibrated, remaining 40 contracts incomplete. Not comparable with historical trading outcomes.
